title: Gerald Ford: Unelected
titleZh: 杰拉尔德·福特：未经选举上任
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来“美国总统”系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about Gerald Ford.
sentences.zh: 今天我们聊一聊杰拉尔德·福特。

sentences.en: Ford was the 38th president, but he was never elected to the position.
sentences.zh: 福特是第38任总统，但他从未通过选举担任这一职位。

sentences.en: Instead, an unusual series of events brought him there.
sentences.zh: 相反，是一连串不寻常的事件让他走上了这一位置。

sentences.en: Many historians have described Ford as a good man facing a difficult situation.
sentences.zh: 许多历史学家将福特描述为一位身处困境的好人。

sentences.en: He tried to fix a troubled economy, end United States' involvement in Vietnam, and show people that the U.S. government could continue to operate after a crisis.
sentences.zh: 他试图整顿陷入困境的经济，结束美国在越南的卷入，并向人们表明，经历危机之后美国政府仍能正常运转。

sentences.en: Critics from the two main political parties had problems with Ford’s efforts.
sentences.zh: 两大政党的批评者对福特的努力颇有微词。

sentences.en: And voters did not elect him president when they had the chance in 1976.
sentences.zh: 1976年，当他们有机会选举他当总统时，选民们并没有这么做。

sentences.en: But he is remembered in American history for making many voters feel better about their elected officials.
sentences.zh: 但在美国历史上，他因让许多选民对民选官员的感觉更好而被铭记。

sentences.en: When he was born, the future president was given his father’s name: Leslie Lynch King.
sentences.zh: 出生时，这位未来的总统被取了他父亲的名字：莱斯利·林奇·金。

sentences.en: But the boy’s father was abusive.
sentences.zh: 但这个男孩的父亲有暴力倾向。

sentences.en: His mother separated from him a short time after their son was born.
sentences.zh: 儿子出生后不久，他的母亲便与他分居。

sentences.en: She asked a court for permission to cancel their marriage.
sentences.zh: 她向法院申请解除他们的婚姻。

sentences.en: Her request was quickly approved.
sentences.zh: 她的请求很快获得批准。

sentences.en: She and the boy moved from the Midwestern state of Nebraska to Michigan.
sentences.zh: 她和男孩从中部内布拉斯加州迁至密歇根州。

sentences.en: In a few years, the mother married a man named Gerald Ford.
sentences.zh: 几年后，这位母亲嫁给了一位名叫杰拉尔德·福特的男子。

sentences.en: The couple had three sons together.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇一共育有三个儿子。

sentences.en: The new family was warm and loving.
sentences.zh: 这个新家庭温暖而充满爱意。

sentences.en: In time, the oldest boy officially took his step-father’s name and became Gerald Rudolph Ford, Junior.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，最大的男孩正式采用了继父的名字，成为杰拉尔德·鲁道夫·福特小。

sentences.en: He was called Jerry for short.
sentences.zh: 他的小名是杰瑞。

sentences.en: Growing up, Jerry Ford was a well-liked person and a good student.
sentences.zh: 在成长过程中，杰拉尔德·福特是一个受人喜爱的人，也是一名品学兼优的学生。

sentences.en: He was also a top football player.
sentences.zh: 他还是一名顶尖的橄榄球运动员。

sentences.en: He was named the most valuable player on his team at the University of Michigan.
sentences.zh: 他被密歇根大学所在球队评为最有价值球员。

sentences.en: After finishing college, he was offered work with professional football teams.
sentences.zh: 大学毕业后，他收到了职业橄榄球队的邀请。

sentences.en: But Ford wanted to continue his education instead.
sentences.zh: 但福特选择继续深造。

sentences.en: He accepted coaching positions for the football and boxing teams at Yale University in Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 他接受了位于康涅狄格州的耶鲁大学橄榄球队和拳击队的教练职位。

sentences.en: In time, he attended the law school there.
sentences.zh: 后来，他在那里就读法学院。

sentences.en: Ford’s path to politics was similar to that of other presidents during that period.
sentences.zh: 福特走向政治道路的经历与那个时期的其他总统相似。

sentences.en: He worked at a law office in his home state.
sentences.zh: 他在家乡的一家律师事务所工作。

sentences.en: He fought in World War II. He married.
sentences.zh: 他参加了第二次世界大战，并结了婚。

sentences.en: Ford’s wife was Elizabeth Bloomer.
sentences.zh: 福特的妻子是伊丽莎白·布卢默。

sentences.en: Her friends called her Betty.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友们都称她为贝蒂。

sentences.en: She had been a dancer and worked as a fashion model.
sentences.zh: 她曾是一名舞者，并从事时装模特工作。

sentences.en: The Fords went on to have four children.
sentences.zh: 福特夫妇后来又育有四个孩子。

sentences.en: When Gerald Ford was 35 years old, he launched his political career.
sentences.zh: 当杰拉尔德·福特35岁时，他开始了自己的政治生涯。

sentences.en: The Republican Party chose him as its candidate for a seat in the U.S. House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 共和党选择他作为美国众议院席位的候选人。

sentences.en: Ford was elected to represent his home area of Grand Rapids, Michigan.
sentences.zh: 福特当选，代表其家乡密歇根州的大急流城。

sentences.en: But unlike many other politicians, he did not move on to the Senate or become governor of a state.
sentences.zh: 但与许多其他政治家不同，他并未进入参议院或出任州长。

sentences.en: Instead, he stayed in the House of Representatives for 25 years.
sentences.zh: 相反，他在众议院任职达25年之久。

sentences.en: The job of congressman was, in many ways, a good choice for Ford.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，众议员这一职位对福特来说是个很好的选择。

sentences.en: He was well-liked by many voters and other lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 深受众多选民和其他立法者的喜爱。

sentences.en: He could help different groups come to agreement.
sentences.zh: 他能够帮助不同群体达成共识。

sentences.en: He took increasingly important positions on political issues, and in time became the top person in his party in the House.
sentences.zh: 他在政治议题上占据越来越重要的立场，并最终成为众议院中本党的最高领导人。

sentences.en: Ford was a strong supporter of Republican presidents.
sentences.zh: 福特是共和党总统的坚定支持者。

sentences.en: In the 1968 election, Ford advocated for Richard Nixon.
sentences.zh: 在1968年的选举中，力荐理查德·尼克松。

sentences.en: Ford liked Nixon’s plans for the United States, as well as his efforts to improve relations with China and the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 福特赞同尼克松为美国制定的计划，以及他改善与中国和苏联关系的努力。

sentences.en: Both Ford and Nixon were re-elected to their positions in 1972.
sentences.zh: 1972年，福特和尼克松双双连任原职。

sentences.en: But by then, major problems had come to light in Nixon’s administration.
sentences.zh: 但到那时，尼克松政府的主要弊端已暴露出来。

sentences.en: One problem in the early 1970s related to Nixon’s vice president, Spiro Agnew.
sentences.zh: 1970年代初的一个问题涉及尼克松的副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽。

sentences.en: Agnew had been vice president since 1969.
sentences.zh: 阿格纽自1969年起担任副总统。

sentences.en: Five years later, officials found evidence that he had accepted money from contractors, both while Maryland’s governor and as vice president.
sentences.zh: 五年后，官员们发现证据，证明他在担任马里兰州州长及副总统期间均接受了承包商的钱财。

sentences.en: In answer, Agnew resigned from the vice presidency.
sentences.zh: 对此，阿格纽辞去副总统职务。

sentences.en: Normally, voters elect a vice president along with a president every four years.
sentences.zh: 通常，选民每四年随总统一并选举一位副总统。

sentences.en: But by coincidence, the U.S. Constitution had recently been updated to say what happens if the country needs a vice president unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 但巧合的是，美国宪法近期刚被修订，明确了若国家意外需要副总统时应如何处理。

sentences.en: It states that the president has to nominate someone for the position.
sentences.zh: 其中规定，总统须提名一人出任该职。

sentences.en: Then, a majority of lawmakers in Congress must agree.
sentences.zh: 随后，国会中的多数立法者必须表示同意。

sentences.en: So, in 1973, Nixon nominated Gerald Ford to take Agnew’s position.
sentences.zh: 因此，1973年，尼克松提名杰拉尔德·福特接替阿格纽的职位。

sentences.en: Nixon was not especially close to Ford.
sentences.zh: 尼克松与福特并无特别亲密的关系。

sentences.en: But, he knew a majority of lawmakers would likely accept him as vice president.
sentences.zh: 但他知道，国会多数立法者很可能同意他出任副总统。

sentences.en: They did.
sentences.zh: 果然如此。

sentences.en: However, Ford did not serve in the position long.
sentences.zh: 然而，福特并没有在这个职位上待太久。

sentences.en: In eight months, another unexpected event put him in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 在八个月的时间里，另一件意外事件让他进入了椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: In August 1974, President Richard Nixon resigned from office.
sentences.zh: 1974年8月，理查德·尼克松总统辞职。

sentences.en: He was the first president to do so.
sentences.zh: 他是第一位这样做的总统。

sentences.en: As a result, the vice president, Gerald Ford, became president.
sentences.zh: 因此，副总统杰拉尔德·福特成为了总统。

sentences.en: Ford was sworn-in as president on August 9, 1974.
sentences.zh: 福特于1974年8月9日宣誓就任总统。

sentences.en: Then he spoke to the nation on television.
sentences.zh: 然后他在电视上向全国发表讲话。

sentences.en: He said, “My fellow Americans, our long national nightmare is over.”
sentences.zh: 他说：“我的美国同胞们，我们漫长的国家噩梦结束了。”

sentences.en: He told people, “Our Constitution works.
sentences.zh: 他对人们说：“我们的宪法运转良好。

sentences.en: Our great republic is a government of laws and not men.”
sentences.zh: 我们伟大的共和国是一个法治而非人治的国家。”

sentences.en: The public had understandably lost a good deal of faith in government officials, and especially in Richard Nixon.
sentences.zh: 公众 understandably 对政府官员尤其是理查德·尼克松失去了很多信任。

sentences.en: Ford wanted to re-establish their trust.
sentences.zh: 福特想要重新建立他们的信任。

sentences.en: But a few weeks after taking office, Ford used his presidential powers to pardon Nixon.
sentences.zh: 但是，在就职几周后，福特动用总统权力赦免了尼克松。

sentences.en: The pardon meant that Nixon would never face a criminal trial or, if found guilty, punishment for his actions.
sentences.zh: 这一赦免意味着尼克松永远不会面临刑事审判，或者即使被判有罪，也不会受到惩罚。

sentences.en: Ford said he believed pardoning Nixon would help Americans begin to recover from their painful experience with the former president.
sentences.zh: 福特说他相信赦免尼克松能帮助美国人开始从与这位前总统的痛苦经历中恢复过来。

sentences.en: But instead, the move angered many people.
sentences.zh: 但相反，这一举动激怒了很多人。

sentences.en: They believed that Nixon should be held responsible.
sentences.zh: 他们认为尼克松应该承担责任。

sentences.en: They also lost some of their trust in Ford.
sentences.zh: 他们对福特的信任也减少了一些。

sentences.en: In addition to these political troubles, Ford faced other difficult issues.
sentences.zh: 除了这些政治麻烦之外，福特还面临着其他困难的问题。

sentences.en: The American economy was struggling.
sentences.zh: 美国经济正处于困境之中。

sentences.en: His administration had to deal with unemployment, inflation and the lasting effects of an energy crisis.
sentences.zh: 他的政府不得不应对失业、通货膨胀以及一场能源危机的持久影响。

sentences.en: The high price of oil imports came at a time when Americans were using more and more gasoline.
sentences.zh: 石油进口的高价出现在美国人使用汽油越来越多的时候。

sentences.en: Ford took steps aimed at improving the economy.
sentences.zh: 福特采取了旨在改善经济的措施。

sentences.en: But critics said he was not consistent.
sentences.zh: 但批评者说他言行不一。

sentences.en: Some criticized him for increasing government spending and cutting taxes; others criticized him for reducing government spending and raising taxes.
sentences.zh: 有人批评他增加政府开支、削减税收;也有人批评他减少政府开支、提高税收。

sentences.en: Ford also oversaw the withdrawal of Americans from Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 福特还监督了美国人从越南的撤出。

sentences.en: An earlier agreement had brought a ceasefire to groups in South Vietnam, North Vietnam, and Communist forces.
sentences.zh: 此前的一项协议为越南南方、越南北方和共产主义武装力量带来了停火。

sentences.en: The U.S. officially withdrew its combat troops in 1973.
sentences.zh: 美国于1973年正式撤出作战部队。

sentences.en: But the fighting restarted.
sentences.zh: 但战斗重新爆发。

sentences.en: Ford asked Congress to approve military and humanitarian aid for the area.
sentences.zh: 福特要求国会批准对该地区的军事和人道主义援助。

sentences.en: But U.S. lawmakers did not approve the full amount.
sentences.zh: 但美国立法者并未批准全额款项。

sentences.en: And in time, they cut military aid.
sentences.zh: 而且随着时间的推移,他们削减了军事援助。

sentences.en: In 1975, Communist forces began to take control of Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 1975年,共产主义武装力量开始控制南越首都西贡。

sentences.en: Ford ordered all remaining Americans in the country to leave, along with any South Vietnamese who were connected to the United States.
sentences.zh: 福特命令该国境内所有剩余的美国人以及任何与美国有关联的越南南方人员撤离。

sentences.en: He said that, as far as Americans were concerned, the Vietnam War was finished.
sentences.zh: 他表示,就美国人而言,越南战争已经结束。

sentences.en: Americans did not appear to blame Ford for the troubling end of the country’s involvement in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 美国人似乎并没有把对国家卷入越南战争的麻烦结局归咎于福特。

sentences.en: And some recognized that the country’s economic and energy problems had started long before he became president.
sentences.zh: 而且有些人认识到,国家的经济和能源问题在他就任总统之前很久就已经出现了。

sentences.en: But, in general, Ford did not have the support of Congress.
sentences.zh: 但一般来说,福特没有得到国会的支持。

sentences.en: And many voters did not forgive him for pardoning Nixon.
sentences.zh: 而且许多选民没有原谅他赦免尼克松。

sentences.en: In 1976, Ford officially campaigned for president for the first time.
sentences.zh: 1976年,福特首次正式竞选总统。

sentences.en: He won his party’s nomination in a close race against Ronald Reagan, the former governor of California.
sentences.zh: 他在与前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根势均力敌的竞争中赢得了本党提名。

sentences.en: But he lost the general election to the Democratic candidate, who said one of his best qualities was that he did not have experience in the federal government.
sentences.zh: 但在大选中，他输给了民主党候选人，而该候选人称自己最大的优点之一就是没有联邦政府的工作经验。

sentences.en: The argument appeared persuasive to many voters, who still did not appear to be enthusiastic about the government.
sentences.zh: 这一说法对许多选民颇具说服力，而他们显然对政府仍提不起兴趣。

sentences.en: In the 1976 election, nearly half of all people who were legally able to vote chose not to.
sentences.zh: 在1976年的选举中，几乎有一半依法拥有投票权的人选择了弃权。

sentences.en: Ford left the presidency graciously.
sentences.zh: 福特优雅地离开了总统之位。

sentences.en: He said that, because he had not planned to be president, he was thankful for the unexpected opportunity.
sentences.zh: 他表示，由于自己原本并未打算成为总统，他对这突如其来的机遇心存感激。

sentences.en: Although Ford said he was ready to retire from politics, he continued to be active in public life.
sentences.zh: 尽管福特称自己已准备退出政坛，但他依然活跃于公共生活之中。

sentences.en: He advised others on government affairs, published books, and sat on boards and committees.
sentences.zh: 他就政府事务向他人提出建议，出版了多本书籍，并担任多个理事会和委员会的成员。

sentences.en: His wife, Betty Ford, also left a lasting effect on the public.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子贝蒂·福特同样对公众产生了深远影响。

sentences.en: As first lady, she had spoken about her experience with breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 作为第一夫人，她曾谈及自己与乳腺癌抗争的经历。

sentences.en: After her husband left the presidency, she also spoke openly about her battle with alcohol and drug abuse.
sentences.zh: 在丈夫卸任总统后，她也公开讲述了自己与酗酒及药物滥用作斗争的经历。

sentences.en: In 1982, Betty Ford co-founded the Betty Ford Center in California to help people get treatment for drug addiction.
sentences.zh: 1982年，贝蒂·福特在加利福尼亚州共同创办了贝蒂·福特中心，帮助药物成瘾者接受治疗。

sentences.en: She announced her husband’s death in 2006.
sentences.zh: 她于2006年宣布了丈夫的逝世。

sentences.en: Gerald Ford died of heart disease at the age of 93.
sentences.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特因心脏病逝世，享年93岁。

sentences.en: By that time, most the public had accepted that one of Ford’s biggest achievements was to help the country recover after Nixon resigned.
sentences.zh: 到那时，大多数公众已接受这样一个事实，即福特最大的成就之一是帮助国家在尼克松辞职后走出困境。

sentences.en: President Bill Clinton gave Ford a Presidential Medal of Freedom for his efforts.
sentences.zh: 比尔·克林顿总统因他的努力向他颁发了自由勋章。

sentences.en: And even Jimmy Carter, who beat Ford in the 1976 presidential election, began his inauguration speech by thanking Ford.
sentences.zh: 甚至在1976年总统竞选中击败福特的吉米·卡特，也在其就职演说开始时感谢了福特。

sentences.en: Carter said, “For myself and for our Nation, I want to thank my predecessor for all he has done to heal our land.”
sentences.zh: 卡特说：“无论是对我个人，还是对我们国家，我都想感谢我的前任为治愈我们的土地所做出的一切。”

sentences.en: I’m Kelly Jean Kelly.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·简·凯利。
